annotations.title: Copy an AppLovin creative set into another campaign (paused)

description: Copy an AppLovin creative set into another campaign, born PAUSED and read back. AppLovin only clones a set that already belongs to a campaign. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.

campaignId.description: the campaign to copy it into

creativeSetId.description: creative set to copy; it must already belong to a campaign
